bull.t: Rapid revenue growth with improving margins
bull.b: The sharp improvement in revenue, gross margin and adjusted EBITDA indicates that acquired businesses and core agency operations are gaining scale. If sustained, better operating leverage can strengthen the company’s earnings trajectory and reduce the gap between growth and profitability over the next several quarters.

TubeBuddy adds a software-led revenue stream with substantially higher stated margins than the broader business. Subscriber growth and stronger conversion among activated users could improve mix, recurring monetization and cash generation as product adoption expands within the gaming ecosystem.

bull.t: Visible booked revenue and client retention
bull.b: A large locked-in revenue base and complete renewal rate among agency-of-record clients provide useful visibility into near-term execution. This supports management’s reiterated FY2026 outlook and suggests that established client relationships can underpin repeat business beyond individual campaigns or events.

bear.t: Severe losses and persistent cash burn
bear.b: Despite strong reported growth, the company remains deeply unprofitable and continues to consume substantial cash. Until operating improvements translate into durable GAAP profitability and positive free cash flow, GameSquare may remain dependent on external capital and have less flexibility to fund expansion.

bear.t: Rising leverage and weaker equity cushion
bear.b: The sharp increase in leverage against a backdrop of heavy losses weakens financial resilience and reduces the equity cushion supporting the business. Higher obligations can constrain capital allocation and make the company more sensitive to execution setbacks while profitability remains unproven.

bear.t: Material dilution from the FanEngine acquisition
bear.b: The proposed stock-based acquisition could materially dilute existing holders before the acquired assets demonstrate their contribution. Additional earnout shares and contingent cash payments further increase potential consideration, so the transaction’s value depends on achieving demanding growth and profitability targets.
